name: VITRO Davao
notes: SunStar reported PLDT/ePLDT launched the first data center facility in Mindanao in Davao on Feb. 13, 2017 with 44 racks; capacity estimate from OCOLO listing.

name: STT Davao
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres Philippines
notes: Official STT GDC location page lists a Davao City data centre directly connected to the SEA-US submarine cable system with 0.5 MW IT load.

name: DITO Davao Edge Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings identify an edge facility on MacArthur Highway, Davao City supporting DITO's 5G network; no reliable capacity found.

name: Bangsamoro Government Center Data Center
developer: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao / Office of the Chief Minister
notes: BARMM official news reported inauguration of a new data center in Cotabato City on Jan. 22, 2026 for centralized hosting of core systems and data management; 2024 reports described the P27.1M data-management/data-center project.

name: VITRO Sta. Rosa
notes: Official VITRO page describes the Laguna AI-ready hyperscale facility; trade/local press reported the April 2025 launch and 50 MW five-hectare campus in Sta. Rosa, Laguna.

name: VITRO Cavite
notes: PLDT confirmed it was evaluating/planning a 12th VITRO data center in General Trias, Cavite; reports describe up to 100 MW IT load, construction targeted from 2026 and completion by 2028.

name: YCO Cloud Campus One / YCO Malvar One
notes: YCO official pages place Campus One at Light Industry and Science Park IV, Malvar, Batangas; trade press reported launch in July 2023 and aggregator data lists 12 MW critical IT workload.

name: DITO Batangas Super Core Data Center
notes: ZTE announced joint launch of the DITO Super Core Data Center in Batangas; Uptime Institute lists DITO Telecommunity Batangas Super Core Data Center (CO3). Capacity not found in reliable public sources.

name: STT Cavite 1
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres Philippines
notes: STT GDC official locations include STT Cavite 1 in General Trias; DCD reported the campus opened in 2015 and Cavite 1 offers 4.8 MW.

name: STT Cavite 2
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres Philippines
notes: STT GDC says Cavite 2 is launching soon at General Trias and earlier official/trade sources describe up to 6 MW IT capacity; retained as construction because the official locations page still marks it launching soon.

name: Evolution DC Philippines / Megawide Cavite Campus
developer: Evolution Data Centres / Megawide Construction Corp.
notes: Evolution and Megawide announced a long-term 69 MW carrier-neutral data-center campus in Cavite, with an initial 23 MW phase on a four-hectare property; Evolution market page places it at Gateway Business Park, General Trias.

name: Digital Halo MNL1 Data Center Campus
notes: Digital Halo official MNL1 page lists Cainta, Rizal with 6.5 MVA IT for Building 1 and expansion capacity up to 70 MW across MNL1-3; DCD/RCBC reported financing for MNL1 construction/development.
